notes: The size list stops offering what does not work. A height this phone has refused is remembered and marked in the list as one that did not play here, and the tab never chooses it for you again; nothing under 360p is offered unless it is all the video has.
The music video opens on the second the song is on, and says which second that was, instead of starting at the top of the clip while the song plays on two minutes in.
The tab follows the queue. When the song moves on, the picture moves with it: the new song video opens on that song own second, and its results are what NEXT walks.
A song with no music video shows its cover art, with the song playing as the sound, instead of a black rectangle with a line on it.
